     something the next patch generation can learn from." -->

## Reviewer decision

- [ ] Merged as is
- [ ] Merged after edits
- [ ] Rejected

## If rejected, why? (pick one)

- [ ] Wrong approach
- [ ] Wrong root cause
- [ ] Breaks compliance
- [ ] Security concern
- [ ] Doesn't address the root cause
- [ ] Already fixed elsewhere
- [ ] Business context the model couldn't see
